axes.model_access: The base is Meta's self-developed Llama family (an open-weights family — downloading weights to self-deploy is a separate line, see the Llama series entries on the models site); in-product model versions and switching form not verified item by item.
axes.runtime: Web (meta.ai) + apps, deeply embedded as AI entries inside WhatsApp/Instagram/Facebook/Messenger; generation runs on Meta's cloud, nothing runs locally. www.meta.ai returned 403 to headless fetching on the day (Cloudflare block, not a dead link).
axes.local_files: Chat history stored on the Meta account side, under the same account system as the social graph; no locally-held data surface declared by the vendor — downloadable open weights for self-deployment is a separate line (see the Llama family entries on the models site); product chat data does not land on your machine with the weights.
axes.background: Chat returns instantly; no official statement verified for an async-task form. Whether sessions interoperate between the in-app entries (WhatsApp/IG) and the standalone site (meta.ai), and how histories link, was not verified item by item.
axes.tools: Image generation (the Imagine line), web and other capabilities are on record in the official narrative; no MCP support verified in official statements.
axes.context: Chats organized per conversation; cross-app history linkage across Meta surfaces not verified item by item; no official statement verified for cross-session memory.
axes.permissions: Meta account system (sharing one account with the social graph is its biggest permission surface); training-usage toggle path not verified item by item — Meta's data-use terms have historically been sensitive, read the official privacy page item by item.
axes.fit: Fits: users already working inside Meta apps (WhatsApp/IG), wanting free chat + image generation. Not a fit: leaving the Meta account, direct mainland access (not filed), running weights locally inside the product.
